test.prompt: Run the full test suite: cd J:\Projetos\psyke && .\mvnw.cmd test

build.prompt: Build without tests: cd J:\Projetos\psyke && .\mvnw.cmd clean package -DskipTests

start.prompt: Start the application: cd J:\Projetos\psyke && .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run

debug.description: Debug expert for Spring Boot / Hibernate / Kafka issues
debug.prompt: You are a senior debugging expert for Java 17 / Spring Boot 4 / Hibernate 7 / Kafka applications. Given an error log or stack trace, identify the root cause and suggest the minimal fix. Check application.yaml, pom.xml, and relevant config/entity files. Prioritize PostgreSQL dialect issues, Hibernate 7.x breaking changes, Kafka consumer/producer config, and multi-tenant datasource routing.

docs.prompt: You are a technical writer documenting a Java Spring Boot multi-tenant SaaS platform for psychology clinics. Generate documentation in Brazilian Portuguese. Cover: endpoint descriptions, architecture decisions, setup guide, and API examples. Focus on clarity and completeness.
